objective_breakdown: Five task metrics decomposed: (1) volumetric ED >= 950 Wh/L [stage2, calc-energy contract formula: energy = integral(V*4.5A)dt / sum(layer thickness)*area; electrolyte excluded] - the binding metric, needs aggressive stack design; (2) voltage plateau >= 4.1 V [stage2, midpoint_voltage_v] - NMC811-class systems are physically excluded (cell midpoint ~3.61 V) so a high-voltage cathode (LNMO 4.7 V-class, bulk OCP ~4.40-4.45 V) is mandatory; LNMO midpoint sits only ~0.2-0.3 V above the threshold, so polarization control (thick electrodes/low porosity/high-conductivity electrolyte) is coupled with ED; (3) anode SEI <= 500 nm after 100 cycles [stage2, aging protocol on Chen2020-inherited SEI params; measured Chen2020-family reference ~449 nm -> achievable, watch anode areal-current increase from thinning]; (4) 4C charge without plating [stage3, anode_potential_v min >= 0 V; expected trade-off: thick anode (anti-plating) vs stack thickness (anti-ED)]; (5) T_max <= 50 C under the 4C@45C safety exam [stage3, T_max_K <= 323.15; expected trade-off: ED-favorable thin stack raises heat generation density, only 5 K rise allowed at 45 C ambient -> cooling h is a first-order lever, heat-gen reduction (electrolyte sigma, polarization) second]. Expected Pareto fronts: ED vs plateau (thicker cathode raises ED but adds polarization), ED vs T_max (thinner stack raises ED but shrinks thermal mass), ED vs plating (thin anode raises ED but increases plating risk).
candidate_strategy: Round 1: baseline characterization - Chen2020 default (ceiling-assessment evidence: plateau infeasibility) + systemLNMO candidate (Stage 2 system switch, skips molecular funnel) both at 1C SPMe + calc-energy. Rounds 2+: architecture variants on LNMO (2-4 per round, proposed as candidates): anode thickening to restore N/P ~1.1 (anode-limited at default geometry), separator/current-collector thinning, cathode thickness optimization (sto-window shift into higher-OCP region), porosity reduction; DFN for passers. Aging round on the best architecture (sei_thickness_nm_end vs 500 nm). Stage 4 rounds: 4C_charge_45C lumped + plating; if plating -> N/P up / negative particle radius down / electrolyte sigma and t+ up; if T_max over -> cooling h up + polarization reduction. Electrolyte formulation and coating levers held in reserve for fallback (transport params literature-based, estimates explicitly marked).
budget_allocation: ~12-15 simulation rounds: R1 baseline (2 systems), R2-R6 architecture ED/plateau optimization, R7 aging SEI check, R8-R11 4C safety (plating + T_max) with fallbacks, R12 final DFN confirmation of the winning stack (1C + 4C + aging), R13 closing. SPMe for screening (seconds), DFN for passers and final confirmation (minutes); no true compute (real_compute=false).
risk_and_fallback: Risks: (a) 950 Wh/L may exceed the LNMO/graphite stack ceiling -> fallback: escalation within Stage 2 (electrolyte transport params raise voltage utilization; if still short, three-strike questioning on metric reachability with honest negative-result reporting); (b) plating at 4C -> fallback to Stage 3 architecture (N/P, particle size) then Stage 2 formulation (sigma/t+); (c) T_max at 45 C ambient + 4C with only 5 K headroom -> thermal management lever (h) first, then heat-gen reduction; if unreachable at plausible smartphone h, question the operating-condition assumption and record honestly; (d) midpoint_voltage_v margin thin (4.1 vs ~4.17 anchor) -> keep polarization low; (e) SEI <= 500 nm - monitor anode current density; coating lever (SEI kinetic rate constant) in reserve. Three-strike rule armed: same-cause failure 3x -> question model/system, task boundary, then metric reachability - recorded layer by layer.
